paired: You are now the owner of this bot. Cards and alerts from your agents come here.
pairRefused: This link has expired or was already used. Run `binference telegram pair` for a new link.
pairingEnded: ⚠️ Another Telegram account is now the owner of this bot: someone opened a new link from `binference telegram pair`. Cards and alerts go to that account from now on. Not you? Freeze now: run `binference freeze` on the machine binference runs on.
secretDeleted: ⚠️ Message deleted: it looked like a recovery phrase, a private key or an owner key. Never paste one into a chat. If it was real, treat it as exposed. To share a transaction, paste its block explorer link instead, since a transaction hash looks like a private key.
chat.photosLeftOut: The agent reads 4 photos of a message at most, so {count, plural, one {# photo was} other {# photos were}} left out. Send {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} in another message.
chat.photoTooLarge: The agent reads photos of 5 MiB at most, so {count, plural, one {# photo was} other {# photos were}} left out. Send a smaller copy.
chat.forwarded: A forwarded message does not reach the agent. Write what you want it to read in a message of your own.
chat.edited: An edit does not reach the agent. Send a new message instead.
chat.unsupported: The agent reads text and photos. Send this as text or as a photo.
draft.header: {agent} drafted this token launch. Nothing is uploaded or public until you tap Start launch.
draft.footer: After Start launch, the launch card shows the launch fee, the new token and the least the first buy gets, and you confirm there. This draft ends at {time}.
draft.started: ✅ Launch started. Its card follows: confirm there before anything is signed.
draft.dropped: ❌ Launch draft dropped. Nothing was uploaded.
draft.expired: ❌ This launch draft ended after 10 minutes. Nothing was uploaded. Ask your agent to draft it again.
draft.replaced: ❌ A newer launch draft replaced this one. Nothing was uploaded.
draft.answer.expired: This draft has ended. Ask your agent to draft it again.
draft.noPhoto: ⚠️ binference could not show the picture here, so this draft cannot start. Ask your agent to draft it again.
draft.ended: ❌ The launch ended before its card: {reason}. Nothing was signed.
draft.answer.gone: binference no longer holds this draft. Ask your agent to draft it again.
draft.gone: ❌ binference no longer holds this launch draft, after a restart or a newer draft. Ask your agent to draft it again.
draft.answer.starting: Starting the launch. The draft's message says how it goes.
draft.starting: 🟡 Starting the launch. This message says how it ends.
